name: Redpath Platform Combat Boot
description:
A chunky combat boot with a 4cm platform sole, lace-up front, and a row of D-ring hardware running up the shaft to mid-calf. The upper is matte synthetic leather reinforced at the toe and heel. The platform adds height without sacrificing stability — the sole is wide and flat-bottomed. Available in black only.

A fashion statement with real structural durability. Popular in Tier 2-3 club scenes and among people who want presence in how they walk. Pairs with everything from tailored trousers to ripped legwear.
functionality: reinforced toe and heel, platform stability sole
what_it_says: You take up space deliberately and you're not apologizing for it.
worn_by: people who want to be seen
story_hooks: A street vendor in the Shelf sells Redpath knock-offs with a hollow platform compartment — word spreads quietly among people who need discreet carry.
The D-ring hardware on a found pair has been modified — one ring is a different alloy, suggesting a replacement made in a hurry.
